office_does: The sheriff is the county's chief law enforcement officer, keeping the peace, enforcing state law and executing court orders.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Sheriff Joe Helm, first elected in 2018 and re-elected in 2022, is the only candidate and submitted no statement.

candidates.summary: Columbia County Sheriff since the 2018 election and chief deputy for 11 years before that; submitted no 2026 statement.
highlights: Won in 2018 with 64% and in 2022, 1,306 to 793, both times over Deputy Jeff Jenkins [S5][S6]
In 2022 named crime and drugs his top priority, through community-oriented policing and more staffing [S6]
No 2026 pamphlet or online guide statement [S1][S2]
